liquidityVestingSchedule.assumption: Each 20% liquidity vesting share is released in one tranche after one day, with no cliff.

assumptions: This is a deterministic Devnet review fixture, not a recommended production configuration.
The six explicit liquidityAllocation buckets map directly to SDK percentages; allocationIntent is retained as a separate input and is not expanded or substituted to derive those buckets.
Base-token vesting is disabled; the separate DAMM v2 liquidity vesting schedule is one release at the one-day lock duration.
Fixed-supply excess is calculated from the pinned SDK minimum supply with swap buffer and is assigned to the runtime deployer as leftover receiver.
The SDK custom-curve helper receives one equal weight per segment only to assemble the remaining SDK fields; its generated curve is discarded and replaced with the exact quantized compiler curve.
The compile fixture's slot zero is a simulator clock. The actual pool activation point is established when the pool is initialized.
The Circle Devnet USDC mint address is a candidate only until read-only live mint checks and the full migration gate pass.

The metadata JSON and SVG are hosted on GitHub Pages at stable HTTPS URLs. The fixture retains DEVNET_METADATA_URI_REQUIRED; callers must explicitly resolve the published JSON URI before transaction assembly.
The connected deployer wallet is used for all listed runtime roles. Config and base-mint signer keypairs are created only at runtime and are not stored in this fixture or report.
The pinned SDK DAMM v2 mapping uses the time-linear base-fee mode with a zero-period market-cap scheduler; the seeded 100 bps migrated-pool fee therefore has no fee schedule progression.
